description.value: Eau Vivre Winery is a family-owned estate in the Similkameen Valley near Cawston, BC, purchased in 2017 by Sukh and Neetu Bajwa after years of admiring the region's wine country. The winery produces whites, reds, rosé, and private reserve wines from its Similkameen terroir and has accumulated awards and accolades since opening. Cyclists riding the scenic Similkameen corridor can book a tasting directly through the website, making it a natural stop along one of BC's most picturesque rural cycling routes.

address.value: 716 Lowe Drive, Cawston, British Columbia V0X 1C2

Contact details come entirely from the website (716 Lowe Drive, Cawston V0X 1C2; 250 499 2655) as OSM carries none. The OSM record's addr:unit=109 in a retail building at coordinates that do not match Cawston is suspicious — the OSM node may represent a retail outlet or be misplaced, not the winery estate itself; this is flagged. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
